summary: This video covers the 3rd Anniversary event rewards, promo codes, and optimal start strategies for new and returning Dragonheir players. Skratch outlines how to acquire up to 4 free Legendary heroes early through download links, login events, and the Fate Test web event. He also explains how to navigate beginner banners, Prophecy Summons, and Celebration Servers for maximum rewards.

meta_changes: Celebration Servers launched with doubled daily check-in rewards and accelerated progression.
Account Valuation event introduced to appraise existing account progress for Wyrmarrow payouts.
tips: Start a new account on Celebration Servers launching Sept 15 to receive double daily login rewards.
Complete 20 standard Heliolite pulls to secure the guaranteed early Legendary before using Prophecy codes.
Bind creator code SKRATCH in the store settings to unlock monthly discount packs and free bonus goods.
Avoid locking in beginner Wish banner choices immediately until you see your pulls from limited banners like Child of Chaos.
title: The BEST TIME To START Playing Dragonheir: Silent Gods x Dragonstride
